newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MBf Holdings to buy Indonesian broker.
newsitem.headline: MBf Holdings to buy Indonesian broker.

text.p: Malaysian finance and property group MBf Holdings Bhd said on Tuesday it intended to acquire an Indonesian stock brokerage house for 900 million Indonesian rupiah.

A statement by MBf Holdings to the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange said it was planning to acquire a 50 percent stake or 2.75 million shares in the existing paid-up capital of PT Agung Securities (PTAS) Indonesia from a private individual named Nasarudin Sumintapura.
The purchase would be satisfied by cash, MBf said.
PTAS is a securities company engaged in brokerage, underwriting and fund management activities.
MBf Holdings and Nasarudin will enter a joint venture agreement to own and operate PTAS after the acquisition, MBf said.

Under the terms of the joint venture, PTAS will increase its existing paid up capital of 5.5 billion rupiah to 11 billion rupiah, consisting of 11 million shares of 1,000 rupiah each, after the acquisition.

MBf said the transactions are not expected to have any material effects on the earnings and net tangible assets of the group for the year ending December 31, 1996, but would contribute to future earnings.
